proposition: Sayyid Ḥusayn Akhlāṭī wrote to Ibn Turka, whom he called his bosom companion and the leading luminary among his disciples, urging him to write a work establishing the propositions and conjunctions of the science of letters; MK thinks this was perhaps the Mafāḥiṣ.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to received from Sayyid Ḥusayn Akhlāṭī
mediation.note: Letters to third parties ask or offer favours; the text survives only in copies made after his lifetime (except the marginal letters in MS Majlis 10196).

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
mediation.note: The identification with the Mafāḥiṣ is MK's 'perhaps'
